bio.text: Laura Gillen represents New York's 4th Congressional District, which includes Nassau County's South Shore, and is serving her first term.
She was elected Hempstead Town Supervisor in 2017, the first Democrat elected to that office in 112 years, according to her official biography.
A Baldwin native who lives in Rockville Centre, she attended Georgetown University and law school at Georgetown Law Center and NYU School of Law, and worked as a litigator at Cahill Gordon & Reindel.
